commands.summary: Change one dimension's value or tolerance and regenerate; Creo takes back a value the model cannot regenerate with.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --id
flags.summary: The dimension's name, such as d12.

flags.name: --length
flags.summary: The new value of a linear, radius or diameter dimension.

flags.name: --angle
flags.summary: The new value of an angular dimension.

flags.name: --plus
flags.summary: With --minus: the upper deviation of a plus-minus tolerance.

flags.name: --minus
flags.summary: With --plus: the lower deviation, as a positive amount.

flags.name: --symmetric
flags.summary: A symmetric tolerance of plus or minus this much.

flags.name: --upper
flags.summary: With --lower: the upper limit itself.

flags.name: --lower
flags.summary: With --upper: the lower limit itself.

flags.name: --fit
flags.summary: An ISO 286 fit: capitals for a hole (H7), small letters for a shaft (g6).

flags.name: --basic
flags.summary: Make it a basic dimension, the exact value a geometric tolerance refers to.

flags.name: --nominal
flags.summary: Remove its tolerance.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.
